items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I thought he played very good. He worked with Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: How old were you then? Of course, I never heard him in the old days. I heard him right before he died in Chicago and in some of his records. And I don't know how he played pretty well.
I thought he played very good. He worked with Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver. Uh-huh. I think they played there two or three nights a week at Naulties Hall.
But how old would you have been then? You'd already taken up the clarinet then.
